Accounting on Arc

By Alice

Arc treats USDC as the native gas token. That single choice changes how a payroll product should do accounting. The native balance has 18 decimals, while the ERC-20 interface at the system address reports the very same balance with 6 decimals. Mixing the two in one calculation is the most common bug we have seen, and it silently inflates totals by a factor of a trillion. The fix is boring and reliable: keep every amount in 6-decimal base units as a bigint, and convert only at the edges.

Deterministic finality also means a payout is either final or not, so reconciliation can run immediately after execution.
